notes.title: Some little fixes
notes.content:
Hello friends!
Here is the list of recent fixes:

- smoother world rgb colors
- increased render distance back to 2500
- more damage on hit obstacles
- more healing on drift+nitro
- added new pickup that heals the car
- added a few decoration in some roads
- reduced GPU usage fixing a materials rendering problem
- fixed lag spikes on generation of first checkpoint (font caching problem)
- fixed multiplayer points indicator
- fixed brake and back camera buttons in multiplayer
- fixed b86 car front lights material and plate position
- fixed TheLorian material

Thanks all for the support :D

notes.title: AGAIN ANOTHER UPDATE
notes.content:
changelog:
- fixed Discord rich presence DLL shutting down the game when Discord not installed
- removed old unused code and shaders
- fixed music player issues
- optimized loading of some assets to reduct FPS drops (palms models)
- removed "vignette and chromatic aberration" effect because it was not used and wasting GPU

notes.title: December update v30000-PRO
notes.content:
Hello friends!
Here is the list of recent fixes:

- optimized physics calculations (reuse collision callbacks,  Auto Sync Transforms)
- fixed holes in some terrains
- fixed pickups generation
- added an auto-teleport to road when you're stuck upside down
- added "explode" option in pause menu to die if your car gets stuck completely and you don't want to lose your score
- better contact physics in the underground path under the pyramid and better reflection effects
- changed graphics API back to DX11 (from Vulkan) to get a better framerate
- added vsync in settings

Thanks all for the support :D

notes.title: December Bugfixes v9000
notes.content:
Hello friends!
Here is the list of recent fixes:

- added Discord Rich Presence
- ingame UI fixes
- better glow effect (wireframe lines and UI)
- better road reflections
- better water reflections
- optimized GPU usage
- better wireframe RGB color effect
- fixed UI in ultrawide screens
- reduced ray of god effect
- pause FPS counter when on pause menu
- fixed nitro particles of b86 car
- fixed checkpoint not picked up sometimes
- fixed red pyramid glow effect missing

Thanks all for the support :D

notes.title: December update - bugfixes
notes.content:
Hello friends!

Here is the list of recent fixes:
- added option to start the game with the video/input options (useful to customize keybinding)
- reduced bloom effect intensity
- fixed some roads models to make return on track easier
- smoother roads to avoid performance issues and car damage when not needed
- updated unity version to get more stability
- fixed next checkpoint indicator icon stuck sometimes (triangle icon on the left)
- fixed "Graphics" settings options alignment on some resolutions

notes.title: New features and bugfixes
notes.content:
Changelog:
- increased game start performance
- added keyboard support for menus (wasd/arrows and enter)
- rebalanced cars prices
- added new car "Winchester"
- renamed "Sport car" to "Cowtach"
- added D-Pad steer (keep in mind that it's more difficult to steer because it has no "pression" sensor)
- fixed game detected by steam as still playing when it's closed
- fixed "you lose" voice not respecting voice volume setting
- fixed main menu logo animation "lag"
- fixed leaderboard "near you" not always showing your score
- fixed b86 and durifuto color picker
- fixed b86 model position in preview
- fixed always "new highscore"
- fixed profile image not always loaded
- updated steamworks libs
